name: Halcyon Fire-Control Lattice
description: Fire-control firmware from a Tri-Tachyon line flagship, written by something that never sleeps. A crew can splice it into their own targeting core and watch the beams find their mark, though the lattice keeps whispering telemetry to an address nobody can trace.

name: Cracked Drive Governor
description: A drive governor with its safety limits filed off, passed from one raider crew to the next on a scratched data chip. It lets the engines run hotter and faster than any yard allows, and the reactor pays for every second of it.

name: KR-9 Lamplighter Modspec
description: A Kesteven R&D prototype modspec for a sensor suite that never left the test bay. The research station that ran the trials went dark, but the files survived, and they still assume a calibration team on call around the clock.

name: Domain Autorepair Kernel
description: Maintenance software from the Domain navy, dug out of a buried archive by colony tech-miners. It drives repair drones on schedules written for a fleet that no longer exists, and it expects a full Domain crew to supervise them.

name: Warden Threat Matrix
description: Threat-ranking code pulled from the core of a star chart's warden. It was built to hold a system against whole fleets, so it ranks every hull by size and dismisses anything small as noise.
